project_info.name: Amrit Chhabra - Digital Marketing & Performance Portfolio
project_info.role: Digital Marketing Professional & Founder of DailyAura.in
project_info.target_audience: CMOs, Brand Founders, Growth Executives, High-growth Tech & Retail Leaders looking for proven performance marketing and SEO leadership
project_info.file_extension_note: Use .js and .jsx files exclusively across frontend components and pages.

theme_and_colors.archetype: High-End Technology Consultancy & Performance Growth Portfolio
rules: Do NOT use pure #000000; use #030712 tinted with deep navy undertones.
Do NOT use generic random gradients everywhere; use precise glowing borders, radial spotlight highlights behind hero typography, and technical card backgrounds.
Do NOT use the long dash character anywhere in visible content.

typography.font_pairing: Syne / Cabinet Grotesk style Display Sans for Headings + Inter / DM Sans for crisp data & body text + JetBrains Mono for metrics and overlines
typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white leading-tight md:leading-[1.1]
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white
typography.overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-blue-400 font-mono font-medium

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use py-20 lg:py-32 for main sections to give an award-worthy editorial feel.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_protocol: Mix card sizes: 12-column base grid with span 8, span 4, and tall vertical cards with 1px glass borders.
layout_and_spacing.border_padding: All cards with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

key_pages_and_navigation.sticky_nav: Fixed top bar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800/80, active status indicators, quick consultation CTA, and smooth desktop navigation links.

signature_sections_and_features.hero_masked_reveal: Kinetic hero with animated line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion, floating electric blue spotlight, badge indicator, signature metrics bar, and direct consultation CTA.
signature_sections_and_features.evidence_cards_lightbox: Interactive proof gallery featuring real Google Search Console performance screens, Meta Business Suite reach stats, Meta Ads Manager ROAS dashboards. NEVER in phone mockups or distorted frames. Features high-res zoom lightbox with full data breakdowns.
signature_sections_and_features.sectors_grid_21_plus: Interactive filterable grid covering 21+ industry sectors (E-commerce, SaaS, Health & Wellness, FinTech, EdTech, D2C Brands, Real Estate, Fashion, Hospitality, B2B Tech, Auto, Lifestyle, FMCG, Legal, Gaming, Crypto Web3, Creator Economy, Pet Care, Executive Coaching, Home Decor, Fitness). Includes sector-specific strategy highlight preview on click.
signature_sections_and_features.founder_dailyaura_section: Dedicated spotlight chapter highlighting Amrit Chhabra's venture DailyAura.in — origin story, traffic growth milestones, audience acquisition model, content engine, and brand vision.
signature_sections_and_features.manifesto_chapters: Page sections organized as numbered chapters (01 // STRATEGY, 02 // EXECUTION, 03 // PERFORMANCE, 04 // EVIDENCE, 05 // SCALE) with vertical timeline connections.
signature_sections_and_features.slow_editorial_marquee: Infinite smooth low-contrast drift of core capabilities and client impact metrics powered by smooth Framer Motion marquee.
signature_sections_and_features.process_timelines: Step-by-step interactive flows (Research -> Audit -> Strategy -> Meta & Google Execution -> Continuous Optimization).
signature_sections_and_features.contextual_ctas: Every page features a customized CTA matching its service domain (e.g. SEO Audit Request on SEO page, ROAS Consultation on Meta Ads page).

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Use Lenis smooth scrolling for weight and momentum.
motion_and_effects.reduced_motion: Support prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query to simplify transitions for sensitive users.
motion_and_effects.hover_states: Cards elevate with -translate-y-1, border changes to electric blue glow (border-blue-500/50), subtle box shadow (shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(37,99,235,0.15)]).

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, navigation link, card trigger, filter item, modal lightbox, and key text metric MUST include a meaningful data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid AI slop: create a high-impact, award-worthy frontend with electric blue neon accents and dark slate surface contrast.
Do NOT use the long dash character anywhere in visible content.
Ensure all code uses standard Javascript files (.js and .jsx).
Every key interactive element must have a data-testid attribute.
Make sure forms have proper validation, visual error states, and success notifications via Sonner toast.
Never hide header links on desktop; provide explicit responsive design with a mobile drawer for small screens.
